name: The Office Type
source:
The Office Type is a dating simulator/visual novel/puzzle game hybrid. In the game, players live the life of an introverted office intern. You haven't been finding any professional connections, you haven't made any real friends, and there's not much luck in your dating life. But your office supplies have always been there for you! Why not get to know them?

With a birthday wish on a candle in the last office cupcake, eight different types of office supplies come to life, with different human personas for each one. With 24 dateable characters to choose from, players have endless storyline possibilities! Will you date your ballpoint pen? Or maybe a fountain pen is more your style. Your office supplies are waiting for you to romance them!

[Edited from [url=https://www.heavythoughtstudios.com/projects]official website[/url]]
translation:
《The Office Type》融合了恋爱模拟、视觉小说与解谜玩法。玩家将扮演一名内向的办公室实习生：职场人脉没能建立起来，真正的朋友也没交到，感情生活同样不太顺利。但你的办公用品始终陪伴在身边！为什么不试着了解它们呢？

在办公室里最后一个纸杯蛋糕上点起蜡烛，许下生日愿望后，八类办公用品竟拥有了生命，每一类还化身为不同的人格。共有24位可约会角色，带来丰富多样的故事可能！你会和圆珠笔约会吗？还是钢笔更合你的口味？你的办公用品，正等着你与它们谈场恋爱！

[编译自[url=https://www.heavythoughtstudios.com/projects]官方网站[/url]]
